name: @specstride/host-kit
description: Specstride host kit: the host-neutral parts of the host port EP-01 — the logical skill sources and their registry, the generic render with its byte-budget check, the capability-description shape, the self-contained shim core and the reusable doctor host-check set — so a host package composes its plugin from one kit instead of copying engine source (the split of the monorepo, U-1 of 120)
